The main takeaway from our work is that
, in order to achieve efficient exploration, it is important for an agent to have an accurate estimate of the uncertainty in its beliefs about the environment dynamics.

, for the exploration problem, a simple generative model that is trained to minimize the prediction error of the environment dynamics can already achieve a competitive performance, and the variance of the prediction is an informative intrinsic reward.

, for exploration, it is not necessary to explicitly model the environment dynamics; instead, we can use implicit generative models to approximate the posterior distribution of the dynamics, and use the posterior uncertainty as an intrinsic reward.
